notes: The genesis seed is the network identity. Every entropy address, every generated mission, every mined fragment and the whole chromium theme derive from it.
Change the seed and you fork the network: same code, different universe, and no address collision with this one.
Precedence: ENTROPY_GENESIS_SEED env > existing data/entropy/genesis.json > this file > freshly generated random seed.
Committing this file makes handler addresses reproducible for integrators; the per-run data directory stays gitignored.
